summary: In the United States, Testosterone Enanthate has a boxed warning for nerve damage, heart harm, and blood vessel harm [3]. Based on a small computer model rather than tests on people, the drug received low risk scores for both liver and heart issues [M]. A warning also notes that it can cause dangerously high calcium levels in the blood, known as hypercalcemia, in patients who have breast cancer or who cannot move [7].
